card: Logs the resolved target path of the data directory at startup whenever it differs from the configured path, such as when using symlinks. This ensures debug.log records the actual physical storage location used during a run. The author notes this helps developers comparing performance across different storage devices (such as SSD versus HDD) when modifying startup command-line arguments is inconvenient. There are no dependencies.
evidence: Author description: "I've been testing a potential performance PR across different data directories (for example, SSD versus HDD)... changing the startup command arguments may be inconvenient or not even possible. But it's easy to change the default directory to be a symlink."
problem: When the data directory is configured as a symlink, the startup log only records the symlink path rather than its target. Users and developers inspecting debug logs cannot verify the physical storage location (such as an SSD versus HDD) used during a run.

risk.why: Only modifies startup log output to append the resolved canonical path when it differs.

scope_notes: Very small change (+9/-1 lines in 1 file). Diff was not provided.
summary: Logs the resolved filesystem path of the data directory during initialization when it differs from the specified path. This records the actual physical target in debug.log when the datadir or any parent path is a symlink.
